📺 RATINGS ARE UP! The producers are pleased. New casting directives incoming — Wave 2 talent has been released into your sector.
📺 ● LIVE — THE FEAST. the whole village are on television.
📺 🎙️ PLAY-BY-PLAY: And we are LIVE with a special presentation: THE FEAST! The little ones are putting flavored matter in their mouths ON PURPOSE. For joy. The file says joy.

🍖 The feast is warm and good — full bellies, loud laughter — but no keepsake was channeled. The surge must be armed before a feast can carry it: hold a keepsake and channel first. (Feast buff refused: devotion gate.)

💛 You hold Busker's harmonica. Rain, an open case, three dollars and a sandwich. You played anyway — the street owes you nothing, so everything it gives is a gift. You still believe that. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted, devotion ×1.5 — richer feasts hit harder.)
